name: kxnatgasmon
title: Natural gas price on October 30, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT?
settlement: If the close price of the 1-minute candlestick for natural gas on October 30, 2026 at 5:00 PM EDT is above the strike (e.g. 5.899 USD/MMBtu), the market resolves Yes. Settlement uses the price at the end of the 4:59-5:00 PM EDT candle, rounded to 3 decimals; if unavailable, the most recent published price is used.
decideContext: Estimate the effect of the news on the near-term natural gas futures price (USD/MMBtu) at the specific 5:00 PM EDT snapshot on October 30, 2026; the market resolves based on whether that single price point is above or below each listed strike.
